messages:
emily: Quick heads-up: CLI v1.0 is going GA later today. main highlights: new auth flow (API keys + OAuth device flow), opt-in telemetry, and a change to default retry behaviour (now exponential with jitter). please skim the release notes and call out any enterprise concerns.
raj: Nice. Where are the release notes? any breaking flags we should warn users about?
tina: Release notes: https://internal.redwood.dev/docs/cli-1-0-release. Breaking: `--retry` default changed from 0 to exp-jitter (3 attempts). also renamed `--token` -> `--api-key` to make auth less ambiguous.
emily: We'll send a 7-day notice for the auth rename and a 30-day migration period for the retry default. For Hosted we'll keep a runtime compatibility flag `CLI_LEGACY_RETRY=true` for 30 days. Dedicated/Private customers can control this via admin-config.
docs-bot: Docs build passed for cli-1.0: build 4521 -> staging :white_check_mark:
mark: Ops: can we add a snippet showing how to switch to the new auth device flow? Dev teams keep asking for that.
tina: Added examples under "Authentication" with code and terminal flows. Example: \n\n```\n# start oauth device flow\nredwood-cli auth login --device\n# follow url and paste code\n```\n\nAlso added a Python example using the SDK to exchange the device code for a token.
emily: Telemetry is opt-in by default for GA; users will see a prompt on first run and a global config `telemetry.enabled=true|false`. legal, any issues with opt-in wording for EU customers?
legal: Confirmed. Opt-in is fine. We added explicit consent language and a link to the telemetry schema. For Dedicated/Private we default to disabled and note that telemetry endpoints can be routed to customer-managed sinks.
ben: Docs request: add a short migration checklist for repos that use the old `--token` flag and also guidance for CI pipelines (how to export API key as env var).
tina: Done. CI example: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` and `redwood-cli auth whoami` to verify. Also added sed/perl one-liners for bulk flag renames.
raj: For SDK teams: do we need to bump server-side token validation? will tokens issued by device flow be compatible?
emily: Yes, servers already accept both token formats. No action required, but we included tests in canary to validate token exchange and header formats.
docs-bot: Announcement draft saved: https://internal.redwood.dev/announcements/cli-1-0-ga-draft (please review).
emily: Plan: publish docs + announce in #sdk-announcements at 1600 PT. We'll include a pinned FAQ and a 30-day migration dashboard for retry metrics. If no objections, proceed.
mark: No objections from infra. scheduling looks good.
ben: One small ask: include a troubleshooting entry for "CLI hangs on auth login" — some CI runners block device flow. we added a non-interactive fallback in docs.
tina: Added fallback: `redwood-cli auth login --api-key` and note for automation use `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env.
emily: Great. Thanks team 680. I'll publish at 1600 and follow up with the migration dashboard link.
